name: CZM
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用界面牵引与分离关系描述界面开裂、脱黏及损伤演化的模型。
scope_note: 内聚区模型亦称黏聚区模型；具体牵引—分离关系及参数由所采用的本构模型确定。
usage_overview: 用于板式轨道层间界面的损伤分析，以牵引—分离关系刻画黏结、软化至脱黏的过程，研究沉降、列车荷载或温度作用下的界面损伤及其与动力响应的联系。具体关系和参数取决于所采用的界面本构模型。

complete_examples.text: CZM is generally governed by the constitutive relations in form of stress-displacement relationships [31] , such as bilinear, exponential, trapezoidal, etc.

Research in [32,33] have shown that the bilinear CZM is suitable for depicting normal and shear stress-displacement relationships between the track slab and mortar layer and possesses computational compromise in efficiency and accuracy.
The contact behavior among the track slab-filling layer is simulated by the CZM, which will be introduced in Section.
The detailed parameters for the CZM used in this work can be found in Ref. [63].
